title: [3.0-beta5] DIA increase for FIASP
body: Request please to increase DIA limit from 7 to say 8/9/10? I feel the need to try 7.5 or 8 for FIASP and there are various other Facebook posts with people making code changes/edits of 9.

comments.body: Workaround:  Anyone searching for a workaround it has been brought to my attention that a pregnancy increases the max DIA to 10! Not suggesting getting pregnant or any advice but I am trying a Fake pregnancy in my preferences!
I don't see any issues to set it to 10. The important part is that the peak is not off - and we restrict it in the settings to reasonable values.
